orchestrator_sessions.goal: Stabilize high-load research_loop and harden hive-ui against LLM call failures while exposing live metrics.
orchestrator_sessions.summary: Sessions are running under high CPU/memory pressure and research_loop is paused; LLM diagnosis calls are failing with 404/429. The Next.js UI is live and we need immediate guardrails and observability to prevent cascading stalls.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff with jitter to call_llm() in orchestrator.py and implemented /api/metrics endpoint in pages/api/metrics.ts returning session and system stats.
next_steps: Add circuit-breaker and 429/retry handling to call_llm() in orchestrator.py with capped exponential backoff and fallback cache.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns and permission edge cases.
Add exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() with maxAttempts and abort controller.
Implement per-session SLO checks in supervisor.ts throttleSessions() using CPU>=0.85 and mem>=24GB thresholds to pause/reject jobs.
Add /api/sessions/health endpoint to pages/api/sessions/health.ts returning JSON health and backpressure state for each active session.
decisions: Cap research_loop concurrency to 1 and reserve 10% CPU headroom until memory pressure drops below 22GB.
Route LLM calls through a queued dispatcher with priority tiers and reject new low-priority requests when core>1.5 or mem>23GB.
Promote the new /api/metrics endpoint to default dashboard poll target and deprecate legacy scrape paths.

orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() to reduce transient SSE failures under load.
next_steps: Add retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter to call_llm() in orchestrator.py handling HTTP 429/404/5xx with configurable max_retries and backoff_cap
Add /api/metrics endpoint to pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats, load averages, memory/disk pressure, and recent error counts
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns with parameterized fixtures for path traversal and symlink escapes
Define per-session SLOs and backpressure rules in config/slos.json and enforce them in lib/backpressure.ts by throttling or pausing sessions when cpu>0.85 or mem>22GB
Add client-side exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts for sendStream() on non-2xx status codes and network errors with max_retries=5
decisions: Set global retry policy: max 5 attempts with exponential backoff starting at 500ms and jitter ±250ms for LLM and SSE calls
Enforce hard backpressure pauses for sessions when cpu>0.90 or mem>23GB and resume below cpu<0.80 and mem<21GB
Route /api/metrics behind org_guard.py to forbid path traversal and restrict to internal callers via signed token

orchestrator_sessions.goal: Stabilize hive under high load and deliver resilient UI/API observability with backpressure and retries
orchestrator_sessions.summary: Hive is running hot (CPU>1.5, mem~24GB) with paused research_loop and intermittent LLM call failures (404/429). The Next.js UI is live on 3001 but lacks an /api/metrics endpoint and robust retry/backpressure controls. We must immediately harden orchestrator, guardrails, and UI metrics to keep sessions healthy.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() and wired it into the supervisor transport layer to survive transient 429/503 responses.
next_steps: Add retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter to call_llm() in orchestrator.py when HTTP 429 or 503 is returned, with circuit-breaker state per model endpoint.
Write /api/metrics endpoint in pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats (active, paused, cpu/mem/disk, last_error) keyed by session id.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns (absolute paths, symlinks outside workspace, dotfiles, ../ escapes) and assert deny/allow actions.
Add per-session SLO and backpressure enforcement in supervisor.py: if core>0.85 or mem>90% for 30s, auto-nice and throttle accept queue, emit warning metric.
Implement load-aware request throttling in lib/sse.ts: queue depth > 50 or upstream RTT > 2s triggers 429 with Retry-After and jitter delay before next send.
decisions: Prioritize P1 resilience items (orchestrator retries, /api/metrics, org_guard tests) to immediately reduce 404/429 failures and improve visibility.
Adopt exponential backoff with jitter and per-endpoint circuit breakers for all LLM calls to avoid thundering herd under load.
Enforce per-session resource SLOs in supervisor by auto-renicing and throttling when core>0.85 or mem>90% sustained, surfacing state via /api/metrics.
